answer: Each agent identity posts a refundable bond locked in a walnut-hard shell contract: the bond is staked before the agent can act, and any proven Sybil cluster forfeits the whole bond. A newcomer starts at the nadir of trust, earning reputation only through verified work that accumulates like a dune, grain by grain, while a second identity from the same operator must post a doubled bond. Faking one identity costs a small bond; faking a thousand costs a thousand doubled bonds plus the work to build each dune, so the attack price grows faster than its reward.
